clues.it: Olga era nella 7ª colonna e nella 1ª riga, ma non era accanto a un gargoyle.
clues.en: Olga was in the 7th column and in the 1st row, but was not beside a gargoyle.

clues.it: Luca era in una stanza diversa da Olga e da solo nelle Segrete.
clues.en: Luca was in a different room from Olga and alone in the Dungeon.

clues.it: Bruno era accanto a delle catene o a una libreria e da solo nella Sala del Trono.
clues.en: Bruno was beside loose chains or a bookcase and alone in the Throne Room.

clues.it: LA VITTIMA. Era da sola con l'assassino.
clues.en: The Victim. Was alone with the murderer.

clues.it: Fabio era nella 2ª colonna, nella 5ª riga e in Armeria.
clues.en: Fabio was in the 2nd column, in the 5th row and in the Armory.

clues.it: Ugo era accanto a un'armatura e a ovest di Olga.
clues.en: Ugo was beside a suit of armor and west of Olga.

clues.it: Giada era a ovest di Anna e in Armeria.
clues.en: Giada was west of Anna and in the Armory.

clues.it: Carla era accanto a un gargoyle, ma non era accanto a una libreria.
clues.en: Carla was beside a gargoyle, but was not beside a bookcase.

clues.it: Marta era nella 9ª riga e in una stanza diversa da Fabio, ma non era accanto a un trono.
clues.en: Marta was in the 9th row and in a different room from Fabio, but was not beside a throne.

general_clues.en: 4 in the west half of the grid.
4 in the north half of the grid.

steps.it: L'indizio di Olga lascia una sola casella libera: riga 1ª, colonna 7ª.
steps.en: Olga's own clue leaves a single free square: row 1st, column 7th.

steps.it: L'indizio di Bruno lascia una sola casella libera: riga 3ª, colonna 1ª.
steps.en: Bruno's own clue leaves a single free square: row 3rd, column 1st.

steps.it: L'indizio di Fabio lascia una sola casella libera: riga 5ª, colonna 2ª.
steps.en: Fabio's own clue leaves a single free square: row 5th, column 2nd.

steps.it: Incrociando l'indizio di Marta con quelli già usati resta una sola casella: riga 9ª, colonna 9ª.
steps.en: Cross-checking Marta's clue with the ones already used leaves a single square: row 9th, column 9th.

steps.it: Marta può stare solo nella 9ª riga: escludendola, a Carla resta una sola casella: riga 8ª, colonna 3ª.
steps.en: Marta can only be in the 9th row: ruling it out leaves Carla a single square: row 8th, column 3rd.

steps.it: Marta può stare solo nella 9ª colonna: escludendola, a Luca resta una sola casella: riga 2ª, colonna 8ª.
steps.en: Marta can only be in the 9th column: ruling it out leaves Luca a single square: row 2nd, column 8th.

steps.it: Carla può stare solo nella 3ª colonna: escludendola, a Ugo resta una sola casella: riga 6ª, colonna 4ª.
steps.en: Carla can only be in the 3rd column: ruling it out leaves Ugo a single square: row 6th, column 4th.

steps.it: Nessun altro può stare nella 5ª colonna, e lì a Giada resta una sola casella libera: la 7ª riga.
steps.en: No one else can be in the 5th column, and it leaves Giada a single free square there: the 7th row.

steps.it: Nessun altro può stare nella 6ª colonna, e lì a Anna resta una sola casella libera: la 4ª riga.
steps.en: No one else can be in the 6th column, and it leaves Anna a single free square there: the 4th row.
